# InlineEdit

Edits a simple field in place, in lists, table cells and details, without opening a form: a text, a localized
number or a choice from options. The new value is shown right away; if saving fails, it rolls back and the error
is shown below the field.

**Interaction**: in the display state the value is a button; on hover it shows the state layer and an edit
icon. Click it, or press `Enter` or `F2`, to edit: the input gets focus with its text selected. `Enter` saves,
`Esc` cancels and returns focus to the value, and moving focus away saves; a `select` saves as soon as an option
is chosen. Nothing is saved when the value has not changed. While the promise returned by `onSave` is pending,
the new value is shown with a loading indicator and the field cannot be edited again; if it rejects, the value
rolls back and the field reopens with an error (focus returns to the input if it was still on the field).
Validation runs on `Enter` and on blur, then on every change once an error has been shown. Both states have the
same height, so switching does not change the height of a table row, and the text stays in place. With "reduce
motion" on there are no transitions. Values are rendered as text, never as HTML.

**Category**: Data · **Common uses**: Renaming in lists and tables, editing quantities, prices and statuses in table cells, fields of a detail page

## Import

```ts
import { InlineEdit } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

### Basic usage

Click a value, or press `Enter` or `F2`, to edit it; `Enter` or moving focus away saves and `Esc` cancels. The
new value is shown right away while the promise returned by `onSave` is pending. `validate` runs before saving.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  const [name, setName] = useState('Website redesign')
  const [owner, setOwner] = useState<string | null>(null)
  return (
    <Descriptions
      column={1}
      items={[
        {
          key: 'name',
          label: 'Project name',
          children: (
            <InlineEdit
              label="Project name"
              value={name}
              maxLength={80}
              validate={(next) => (next?.trim() ? undefined : 'Enter a project name')}
              onSave={async (next) => {
                // Stands in for a request to the server
                await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 600))
                setName(next ?? '')
              }}
            />
          ),
        },
        {
          key: 'owner',
          label: 'Owner',
          children: (
            <InlineEdit
              label="Owner"
              value={owner}
              placeholder="Add an owner"
              onSave={(next) => setOwner(next || null)}
            />
          ),
        },
      ]}
    />
  )
}
```

### In a table

Edit cells in place: a text, numbers (localized, with `precision` and a range) and a status chosen from
`options`. Both states have the same height, so the rows do not move. Numbers are passed as decimal strings.

```tsx
export function InTable() {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<OrderLine[]>([
    { id: '1', item: 'Linen canvas, 60 x 80 cm', quantity: '12', price: '48.5', status: 'ordered' },
    { id: '2', item: 'Oil paint set', quantity: '4', price: '129', status: 'shipped' },
    { id: '3', item: 'Easel', quantity: '1', price: '310.25', status: 'draft' },
  ])
  const update = (id: string, patch: Partial<OrderLine>) =>
    setRows((list) => list.map((row) => (row.id === id ? { ...row, ...patch } : row)))
  const statuses = [
    { value: 'draft', label: 'Draft' },
    { value: 'ordered', label: 'Ordered' },
    { value: 'shipped', label: 'Shipped' },
  ]
  return (
    <Panel flush>
      <DataTable<OrderLine>
        aria-label="Order lines"
        rowKey={(row) => row.id}
        rows={rows}
        columns={[
          {
            key: 'item',
            title: 'Item',
            render: (row) => (
              <InlineEdit
                label="Item"
                value={row.item}
                validate={(next) => (next?.trim() ? undefined : 'Enter a name')}
                onSave={(next) => update(row.id, { item: next ?? '' })}
              />
            ),
          },
          {
            key: 'quantity',
            title: 'Quantity',
            width: 120,
            render: (row) => (
              <InlineEdit
                type="number"
                label="Quantity"
                value={row.quantity}
                precision={0}
                min={1}
                max={999}
                onSave={(next) => update(row.id, { quantity: next ?? '1' })}
              />
            ),
          },
          {
            key: 'price',
            title: 'Unit price',
            width: 140,
            render: (row) => (
              <InlineEdit
                type="number"
                label="Unit price"
                value={row.price}
                precision={2}
                min="0"
                onSave={(next) => update(row.id, { price: next ?? '0' })}
              />
            ),
          },
          {
            key: 'status',
            title: 'Status',
            width: 140,
            render: (row) => (
              <InlineEdit
                type="select"
                label="Status"
                value={row.status}
                options={statuses}
                render={(v) => (
                  <Pill tone={v === 'shipped' ? 'success' : v === 'ordered' ? 'accent' : 'neutral'}>
                    {statuses.find((s) => s.value === v)?.label}
                  </Pill>
                )}
                onSave={(next) => update(row.id, { status: next ?? 'draft' })}
              />
            ),
          },
        ]}
      />
    </Panel>
  )
}
```

## States

### Failed saves and disabled fields

When saving fails, the value rolls back and the field reopens with what was typed and the text returned by
`onError` below it; press `Enter` to try again or `Esc` to cancel. A disabled field stays readable, and
`disabledReason` explains why it cannot be edited.

```tsx
export function States() {
  return (
    <Descriptions
      column={1}
      items={[
        {
          key: 'title',
          label: 'Title',
          children: (
            <InlineEdit
              label="Title"
              value="Quarterly report"
              onSave={() =>
                // Stands in for a request that fails
                new Promise((_, reject) =>
                  setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Network error')), 600),
                )
              }
              onError={() => 'The server could not be reached. Try again.'}
            />
          ),
        },
        {
          key: 'code',
          label: 'Code',
          children: (
            <InlineEdit
              label="Code"
              value="PRJ-0142"
              disabled
              disabledReason="Codes are assigned automatically"
              onSave={() => {}}
            />
          ),
        },
      ]}
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | Name of the field, such as "Name". Screen readers read the value button as "Edit Name" and the input as "Name" (required: the value alone does not say what is edited). | — | Yes |
| `value` | `V \| null \| undefined` | The saved value; `null`, `undefined` and `""` are empty and show the placeholder. With `type="number"`, pass a decimal string such as `"1250.50"` so that amounts and quantities never go through floating point (a number is accepted too). | — | Yes |
| `onSave` | `(next: V \| null) => void \| Promise<unknown>` | Saves a new value; called only when the value has changed and is valid. The new value is shown right away (optimistic update). Return a promise to show the saving state: until it settles the field cannot be edited again; if it rejects, the value rolls back and the field reopens with what was typed and an error below it. Texts are passed as strings (`""` when cleared); numbers as decimal strings, `null` when cleared, or as a number when `value` was a number; selections as the option value. | — | Yes |
| `type` | `'text' \| 'number' \| 'select'` | Kind of field: `text`, `number` or `select`. | `'text'` | No |
| `options` | `readonly InlineEditOption<V>[]` | Options of `type="select"`; selecting one saves it. | — | No |
| `precision` | `number` | Number of decimal places of `type="number"`: the value is shown with exactly this many and rounded to it when saved. Without it, the value is shown as it is. | — | No |
| `min` | `string \| number` | Smallest allowed value of `type="number"` (a decimal string or a number); smaller values show an error. | — | No |
| `max` | `string \| number` | Largest allowed value of `type="number"` (a decimal string or a number); larger values show an error. | — | No |
| `validate` | `(next: V \| null) => string \| null \| undefined` | Validates the new value before saving: return an error text, or nothing when it is valid. Runs on `Enter` and on blur; after an error, on every change, so the error disappears as soon as it is corrected. | — | No |
| `render` | `(value: V) => ReactNode` | Renders a non-empty value in the display state, for example with a unit or as a Pill. By default the text, the localized number or the label of the option is shown. | — | No |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Text shown when the value is empty, also used as the placeholder of the input; "Not set" by default (follows `locale`). | — | No |
| `maxLength` | `number` | Maximum number of characters of `type="text"`. | — | No |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables editing; the value stays readable. | — | No |
| `disabledReason` | `string` | Disabled reason: shown on hover or keyboard focus while `disabled`, such as "Only the owner can rename the project". With a reason the value can still be focused with `Tab` (`aria-disabled`) and screen readers read the reason (as on Button). | — | No |
| `onError` | `(error: unknown) => string \| undefined \| void` | Called when saving fails (`onSave` throws or its promise rejects). Return a user-readable text to show it below the field instead of "Couldn't save. Try again." (never the raw exception). Without `onError` the error is reported with `reportError`. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
